alerts.headline: Heat Advisory issued October 1 at 9:34AM PDT until October 5 at 10:00PM PDT by NWS Sacramento CA
alerts.description:
* WHAT...High temperatures of 94 to 100 degrees expected, with
widespread Moderate HeatRisk and areas of Major HeatRisk.

* WHERE...Portions of the central and southern Sacramento Valley,
northern San Joaquin Valley, Delta and Carquinez Strait, and
foothills.

* WHEN...From 11 AM Saturday to 10 PM PDT Monday.

* IMPACTS...Hot temperatures may cause heat illnesses.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...Hottest days expected on Sunday and Monday.
alerts.instruction:
Drink plenty of fluids, stay in an air-conditioned room, stay out of
the sun, and check up on relatives and neighbors.
